method: Bounded offline original/Qt PE instruction review; no target execution

contracts.behavior: Diestress opens mode2|10 before DOM and payload reads; failed open logs qDebug and exits. Successful open serializes toByteArray(1), writes once through QIODevice Text, closes and ignores write/close status.
BM writer opens mode2|10 before DOM, object loop and serialization; failed open exits after qDebug. Successful open writes QByteArray then closes, ignoring statuses.

Text branch scans to LF; writes nonempty span via writeData; then separate CRLF2-byte write. Nonpositive return stops with prior consumed count or failure if none. Positive short span is not retried; LF write proceeds and input cursor skips rest of span. Positive CRLF result counts one source byte even if1. Earlier CR bytes are retained.

Six adjacent unwind regions belong to one logical QIODevice::write. First-region-only capture is incomplete. WriteOnly fresh regular files require no seek/read-buffer replay; generic mixed read/write positions remain outside this adapter.
